question:
Select the number from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

7, 16, 41, ?, 171, 292
solution:
**Logic : Square of consecutive odd numbers are added.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c7437004ef897e93f763e8b41ef437cec120ada4e47a3a59fb314fb5c895459d.png]
